assessments.reasoning: The opening of WG14's N3221 editor report assigns C2y working-draft status to N3220 and identifies N3219 as the preliminary ISO DIS draft. Transparency Changes identifies N3220 as the unlocked version for public access and N3219 as the preliminary DIS ballot draft with controlled access. WG14's document log lists both distinct documents and the report under their registered date of 22 February 2024. The exact bytes were retrieved from WG14's document directory and identified by the editor report title and document number. The independently computed SHA-256 equals the registered digest.

challenge.method: Compare the introduction and Transparency Changes with the N3220 cover and WG14's document log. Check whether the similar underlying text or the cover's ISO/IEC 9899:2024 label outweighs the editors' identification of the draft.
challenge.results: The N3220 cover explicitly labels itself a working draft and flags its cover sheet for replacement. The report identifies the two distinct draft products and describes an editorial Annex K footnote change between them. That comparison concerns preliminary documents. IEC separately catalogs the October publication.

limitations: The document status is established by the contemporaneous WG14 report. Textual equivalence to the later published edition remains unverified.
